name: as_of_date
description: The run date (last day of the discharge window); the partition column.

name: rank
description: 1..n by descending risk_score, ties broken by encounter_id ascending.

name: is_top_n
description: rank <= top_n.

name: patient_id
description: Synthea patient id (synthetic).

name: encounter_id
description: Index inpatient encounter id (synthetic); unique per partition.

name: discharge_time
description: Index stay STOP (UTC).

name: admission_reason_code
description: SNOMED-CT reason code of the index stay, if any.

name: admission_reason_description
description: Description of the reason code, if any.

name: risk_score
description: The model's predicted probability of an unplanned 30-day readmission (a ranking, not absolute risk).

name: model_bundle_id
description: Content hash of the model bundle that scored the row.

name: model_run_id
description: MLflow run id the bundle was exported from (provenance).

name: model_name
description: logistic_regression or xgboost_calibrated.

name: top_n
description: The Top-N size of the run.

name: scoring_window_days
description: Window length in UTC calendar days.

name: partition
description: Split partition of the row (always test: the scorer refuses any other).

name: label_definition
description: Label identity of the gold table.

name: gold_fingerprint
description: Content fingerprint of the gold table the model was trained on.

name: gold_reference_date
description: The gold table's reference date (YYYYMMDD).

name: scoring_run_id
description: The scoring_runs attempt that published this row (BigQuery only; not in the local Parquet).

name: gold_fingerprint_definition
description: Fingerprint definition of the gold table (pandas-csv-sha256-v1 or spark-rowhash-v1); null on rows written before v2 slice 7.
